{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check the status column to confirm only 'completed' orders are included
status_counts = sales['status'].value_counts()
print(status_counts)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check revenue dtype and example values
print(f"Revenue dtype: {sales['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"Sample revenue values: {sales['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
age_sentinel_count = (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of customer_age = -1: {age_sentinel_count}")"}
